decisions.text: type table: a table alone: its sole use is looking up individual values (facts.message lookup_only; G1.12)

a table alone, formatted in the book's order: the digits the purpose needs, two thin rules, space between rows and columns, the numbers right-aligned to be compared, nothing bold but the title, the unit once in the title (08-12 DP-4, G7.37–G7.45)
digits: each column at its data's own decimals, one number of decimals down each column (G7.37, G6.16)
the totals last under the darker rule, named in the names' column, in regular weight (D-52 (ii)); the printed totals are the data's, never recomputed
the unit once, in the title; the cells bare numbers (G7.45)

source.shows: the book's lightened table: no fills, borders or stripes, the month headings right-aligned over their numbers, a thin rule under them and another above the totals, the rows well apart; the printed totals kept, although the January and February ones are one more than their rows add up to (D-54); the Total label kept in regular weight (D-52 (ii)), where the book's light version drops it
